text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whistle*...... *BOOM-BOOM!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Fan Appreciation Festival.
An event where fans are invited to Tracen Academy to enjoy a variety of exhibits and performances.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this event, Mejiro Bright was set to compete
against peers she rarely got to meet in actual races.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho, long time no see, Briiiight!
Today, let us treat our fans to a battle
teeming with pure pathos!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! We don't get to race
together very often in sprints!
So today, let's battle in a game instead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Pearl, Lady Taiki,
it is an honor to be working with you~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her opponents are Seeking the Pearl and, equally
rampaging through the sprint division, the cheerful cowgirl,
Taiki Shuttle."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yappee, everyone♪ I'm your host!
The bubbly and totally fab Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What is today's contest~? Whew-whew, it's an Umamusume 'Endurance Contest'~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"A simple endurance contest would be boring,
so we'll have you enter an absurd dimension
using the virtual reality machine, the 'VR Umalator.'"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Which Umamusume will survive in this harsh environment? Alright then, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A harsh environment~?
Umm~ Trainer-sama~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I sent out Mejiro Bright,
who clearly didn't understand the rules
and had a giant question mark on her face.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... Snowy mountains...
Uuu, *chatter chatter chatter*...
It's colder than Kentucky, yes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Let me see~. Now that you mention it's cold,
it does feel a bit chilly~?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... I can't take it anymore... In that case,
Bright, let's race to that cave over there!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And once we arrive, let's all have a campfire
and drink hot milk together!
Here we gooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, my~, Taiki-sama~?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Bzzzt!
Taiki Shuttle-chan, you're OUT~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kentucky-born Taiki Shuttle
was the first to drop out. However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Aah-hah-ha! I won't yield to cold of this level!
Virginia winters were far harsher than this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Now then, let's go-go to the next world♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"'The Cursed American Town!"
How about a horror theme?'"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heh, hehehehe... A place like this is nothing to me.
And why? Because...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm an Umamusume who (plans to) travel the world! Even the underworld won't faze me in the future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: How about you, Bright?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed~, I have worked up quite an appetite~.
Perhaps it is time for some afternoon tea~."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, she's completely oblivious to the mood in the room.
No wonder she looks so fearless in races..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yet victory shall be mine in the end!
Having prepared for every country in the world,
there is no terrain I cannot endure!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
NOOOOO!!! Even for me,
this place wasn't on the expedition itinerary!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"If I actually went, I'd turn into
stardust in an instant!
Ugh, how wonderfully spacey..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~, there's no air left in here~.
How dreadful~.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if there's no air... it's only rough?
As-As expected of a Mejiro Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I lost...
To think there was a cosmic family out there that surpasses world-class levels.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Just you watch, though! Next time, I'll show you I can be an Umamusume who welcomes vacuums with open arms!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And the endurance contest is over~!
The winner is Mejiro Bright-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, my~ I am oh-so-very delighted~.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooooooohh!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She's quite the daring young lady.
To think she can stay so calm even in a situation like that.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's some serious guts.
I'll be rooting for you, Mejiro Bright!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
Just like in this endurance contest, I~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I will do my best in the spring GⅠs as well. So—
I would be most grateful for your continued support.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Wow, she truly is an ojou-sama among ojou-samas!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ah, so neat and overflowing with elegance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
By the waay~, umm~, I'm feeling rather hungry,
so where might Lord Trainer be~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? It is snack time, you know~?
I am going to have a snack~.
Trainer~~~...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is it just me, or...
is this a little different from what I imagined?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... Doesn't exactly look like she's brimming
with guts. At least from what I can tell...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Showing off her trademark patience and airheaded charm,
Mejiro Bright brought great excitement to the event.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aaaalright, since the fans requested it so much,
maybe I'll have a little chat with our winner, Bright-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Bright-chan, I was wondering who you got those nerves of steel from, and then...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: She looks the spitting image of "that person" from Mejiro!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A Mejiro... who might that be?
I don't believe there are many who resemble me...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The one who resembles you the most is—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's the Mejiro Grandmother! Back in the day, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huh... Grandmother?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I read about it in a book, and apparently,
even from a young age, they possessed incredible
mental fortitude and drive.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Back when people rarely traveled overseas,
she was already actively mingling with world celebrities—"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: They arranged a marriage between power couples from prestigious families, and that couple went on to make massive contributions to the Umamusume world, or so I hear.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"She feels like a traditional, old-school commander now,
but apparently she used to be a major star tearing up the scene back in her day."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Howaa... umm... Grandmother is...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes! To be honest, I've always admired heroic tales like that! My bold, go-getter side might be a bit influenced by them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Lady Maruzen too?
To think Grandmother had days like that... And...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: To think that person and I... share some similarities...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, I feel so close to you♪
Even if one of us is in the main Mejiro branch and one isn't,
Bright-chan and I are...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She has a certain relatable strength to her, doesn't she?
I almost feel a touch of destiny here♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I... with Grandmother...?
Ugh, ugh, uuuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh no, are you crying?
Did I say something weird?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, Trainer...
I didn't mean for this to happen...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It didn't look like Mejiro Bright was crying out of sadness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Even within the Mejiro family... I was so inconspicuous... only ever following behind the others... and yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To share such a sacred bond with Grandmother...
Ngh... uuuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Grandmother...
Thank you... *sniffle*...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... Mejiro Bright...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Moved by the moment, the fans in the crowd also teared up.
That shared empathy rippled outward like a gentle wave—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Umm! Things got a bit solemn, but
everyone, please take good care of Bright-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Even if she seems quiet, she's got a feather fan in her heart, making her my true soulmate♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... Everyone~,
thank you so much for your cheering~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to look after me
and my beloved Mejiro for a long time to come~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheers of pure joy echoed through the air,
piercing right through the roof of the venue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An untold story of the previous Mejiro generation was unearthed,
forever etched into the hearts of Mejiro Bright and her fans.
